description: This file fetches chat prompts in both Chinese and English from specified URLs, filters and processes the data, and saves the results to a local JSON file.

methods.name: timeoutPromise
methods.description: Creates a promise that rejects after a specified timeout, used to implement request timeouts.

methods.name: fetchCN
methods.description: Fetches and processes Chinese prompts JSON data from a remote URL, filtering out prompts containing ignore words.

methods.name: fetchEN
methods.description: Fetches and processes English prompts CSV data from a remote URL, parsing and cleaning the data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Coordinates fetching of both Chinese and English prompts and writes the combined prompts to a local file.
